note: No 'Pomona' on the plate. At the expected point the east part of Clayton St. meets Hackberry from the east (T). Clayton jogs at Hackberry: its west part meets Hackberry about 130 px further north at ~(6500, 5232); taken the east part as today's Pomona Court because it matches the expected point.

printed: Street (Taft, name not printed in this stretch)
note: No Stevenson Lane on the plate. Near the expected point there are only large lots (3 and 4) north of the Taft street; a diagonal lot line between lots 3 and 4 reaches the street at about (9325, 5885), not a street. Collins meets Taft at (8997, 5972), and the plate edge runs just south of Taft.

Walter is a short stub cut by the plate edge, meeting Gilbert from the NNW where Gilbert curves. Next to it on the west a '...ta' (Buena Vista) stub also comes in, and there is a small wedge-shaped lot between them. Taken where Walter's centreline meets Gilbert's centreline (car track).

No Madison Road, Victory Parkway or MLK on this part of the plate. The expected point falls in the middle of a block of lots (lots 41-42 and 45-48) between an E-W '... Street' (car tracks, house numbers 1300-1520) at y~4120 and Myrtle Avenue at y~4860, with Ashland Avenue at x~3480 and Durrell Avenue at x~4740. Victory Parkway did not exist in 1922.
Moorman runs N-S and continues as a short stub south of Taft to the plate edge (south side cut by the plate edge just below the crossing). The plate prints 'Taft' with no suffix.

Two short stubs cut by the plate edge, '...TA' (narrow, coming from the WNW) and 'WAL.. ST.' (from the NNW), come together just before both meet Gilbert Avenue. A small wedge lot lies between Buena Vista's south side and Gilbert's west side. Picked where the extended centrelines of the two stubs meet. Their junction with Gilbert is at about (1208, 2283).

printed: Foraker (E-W street; unlabelled east of Mentor)
note: No 'Martin Luther King' on the plate. Mentor St. ends (T) at the E-W street that is labelled Foraker to the west (house numbers 1000-1143). A diagonal street with a partly legible name ('..ONS'?) and an N-S 'Avenue' also come in at this junction from the SW, at about (1900-1990, 3060-3100). Taken the E-W street as today's East MLK Drive, which is uncertain. The pick is about 100 px from the expected point.

Collins runs N-S and continues as a short stub south of the E-W street to the plate edge. The E-W street is the Taft street seen to the west on this plate ('TAFT' printed near x 6200); here only 'ST.' is printed. The plate edge cuts just south of the crossing.

A short stub street ('..ST.' with 12" sewer and W. pipe) is cut by the plate edge and meets Gilbert Ave. from the NNW. Taken where its centreline meets Gilbert's centreline (car track). The name before 'St.' is cut off.

No 'De Sales' on the plate. At the expected point, Lincoln meets Woodburn from the east (T). Taken Lincoln as today's De Sales Lane. West of Woodburn an offset '... Ave.' (likely the west part of Lincoln) meets Woodburn about 100 px further south at ~(5728, 3490). Gilpin Ave. meets Woodburn from the west at y~2810.

Locust is a short stub from the east, cut by the plate edge at x~4850, meeting the diagonal Woodburn. A different street (only 'St.' printed, house numbers 1330-1355) meets Woodburn from the west about 330 px further north at ~(4895, 6058).
